'''B'sant''' was a type of stained [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]]<ref name="GCG" />&mdash;which in turn was a kind of transparent [[Metal/Legends|metal]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|260|transparisteel}}</ref> It was used for decoration by [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]],<ref name="GCG" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema sector]].<ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> The Sullustans eventually also adopted the name of the metal as a [[Gender/Legends|female]] Sullustan name.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
B'sant was mentioned in [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]]'s [[2003]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''.<ref name="GCG" />
